newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduras court overturns rape, murder convictions.
newsitem.headline: Honduras court overturns rape, murder convictions.

text.p: Honduras's highest court on Thursday overturned rape and murder convictions against two soldiers for the 1991 killing of a 16-year-old law student, a court official said.
"The Supreme Court of Honduras annulled the judgment of a lower court against Col. Angel Castillo and Sgt. Santos Ilobares," Justice Rigoberto Espinal said.
He said that there were faults in the way the facts of the case were recorded.
Castillo was sentenced in 1991 to 16 years and six months in prison and Ilobares was jailed for 10 years and six months for the rape and murder of Riccy Mabel Martinez.
The student was last seen near a military establishment where Castillo was in charge. Her badly mutilated body was found two days after.
The victim's mother, Elizabeth Sevilla, said an appeal would be made against Thursday's ruling. Castillo and Ilobares remained in prison pending the appeal.
